diorama.settings.title: Map settings
diorama.settings.gpu_baking.tooltip: Experimental. Draws map tiles on the graphics card instead of the processor, so they appear sooner and the game uses less CPU. The first tiles are also drawn the old way and compared; if your graphics card draws them differently, it switches itself off.
diorama.gpu_baking.failed: GPU baking didn't match on this graphics card, so Diorama is drawing the map on the processor again. The game log has the details.
diorama.settings.minimap_shown.tooltip: Shows the minimap in a corner of the screen.
diorama.settings.compass.tooltip: Puts N, S, W and E on the minimap's edges. The map always faces north.
diorama.settings.coordinates.tooltip: Shows your block coordinates under the minimap.
diorama.settings.biome.tooltip: Shows the biome you're in under the minimap.
diorama.settings.game_time.tooltip: Shows the time of day under the minimap, with or without the day number. It turns blue once it's dark enough to sleep. In the Nether and the End it's the Overworld's time.
diorama.settings.auto_caves.tooltip: When you're underground, the minimap and the map show the cave you're in instead of the surface above.
diorama.settings.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the minimap sits in.
diorama.settings.size.tooltip: How wide the minimap is. It shrinks to fit a small screen.
diorama.settings.enlarged.tooltip: How big the minimap gets while you hold the Enlarge minimap key. Pick that key in Controls.
diorama.settings.zoom.tooltip: How close the minimap is zoomed in. The zoom keys change it too.
diorama.settings.opacity.tooltip: How solid the minimap's map is. Lower it to see the game through it. The frame, icons and text stay solid.
diorama.settings.players.tooltip: Shows other players on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.radar_minimap.tooltip: Shows players, mobs and dropped items on the minimap. Turn this off to reduce lag near large groups of mobs.
diorama.settings.radar_map.tooltip: Shows players, mobs and dropped items on the fullscreen map.
diorama.settings.hostile.tooltip: Shows monsters, like zombies and creepers, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.neutral.tooltip: Shows mobs that only attack when provoked, like wolves, bees and endermen, on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.passive.tooltip: Shows animals, villagers and other harmless mobs on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.items.tooltip: Shows items lying on the ground as small dots on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.range.tooltip: Players, mobs and dropped items farther above or below you than this are left off the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.chunk_grid.tooltip: Draws chunk borders on the map.
diorama.settings.slime_chunks.tooltip: Marks the chunks where slimes spawn on the map. Single player only, in the Overworld: it needs the world's seed.
diorama.settings.spawn_spots.tooltip: Marks blocks on the map where monsters can spawn: those dark even by day, or also those dark only at night.
diorama.settings.claims.tooltip: Where land claimed with FTB Chunks shows, in its team's colour: on the fullscreen map, or on the minimap too.
diorama.settings.drawings.tooltip: Where what you draw on the map shows: on the fullscreen map, or on the minimap too (lines and areas; notes stay on the fullscreen map).
diorama.settings.waypoints_map.tooltip: Shows your waypoints on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.waypoints_world.tooltip: Shows your waypoints in the world, with their distance, even through terrain.
diorama.settings.deaths.tooltip: Adds a waypoint where you die.
diorama.settings.beds.tooltip: Puts a pin on the bed you last slept in.
diorama.settings.map_add_waypoints.toolt: Right-clicking the map offers Add waypoint here and Add temporary waypoint. Off, waypoints are added with their key or from the waypoint list.
diorama.settings.map_waypoints_button.to: The Waypoints button at the top of the map. Off, its key still opens the waypoint list.
diorama.settings.map_settings_button.too: The Settings button at the top of the map. Off, open settings from the mod list, or bind its key in Controls and press it while playing.
diorama.settings.map_maps_button.tooltip: The Maps button at the top of the map, where each dimension's maps are made and switched.
diorama.settings.outlines.tooltip: Darkens the edge where a block stands in front of lower ground, so cliffs and roofs stand out.
diorama.settings.rounded_fog.tooltip: Rounds off the edge of the explored map, instead of following the square edges of chunks.
diorama.settings.fog_of_war.tooltip: Cave maps show only the blocks you've seen, even where the server allows the full map.
diorama.settings.saved_chunks.tooltip: Singleplayer: draws every finished chunk in the world's save on the map, including areas made by tools like Chunky, without walking there. Only the main map, and caves stay hidden. What's already drawn stays when you turn this off.
diorama.settings.quality.tooltip: Fast fills in the map about four times sooner and draws simpler fog. For slower computers.
diorama.settings.type_outline.tooltip: Outlines mob heads in red, yellow or green for hostile, neutral or passive. Off, they're outlined in black.
diorama.settings.player_names.tooltip: Where other players' names show under their heads.
diorama.settings.arrow_color.tooltip: The colour of your own arrow on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.waypoint_labels.tooltip: What shows under waypoints in the world: the distance, plus the name when you're close or looking at it, always, or never.
diorama.settings.waypoint_distance.toolt: Waypoints further away than this leave the world and the minimap; the map still shows them all. Deaths, temporary waypoints and your bed always show.
diorama.settings.waypoint_size_minimap.t: How big waypoints are drawn on the minimap. The steps follow your GUI scale, so the pixels stay sharp.
diorama.settings.waypoint_size_map.toolt: How big waypoints are drawn on the map. The steps follow your GUI scale, so the pixels stay sharp.
diorama.settings.waypoint_size_world.too: How big waypoints are drawn in the world. The steps follow your GUI scale, so the pixels stay sharp.
diorama.settings.teleport_command.toolti: The command Diorama sends to teleport you, for servers with their own instead of /tp. {x}, {y} and {z} become the spot.
diorama.teleport_command.label: Command

diorama.waypoint.folder_tooltip: The folder this waypoint is in. Click to move it to the next one; make folders in the waypoint list.
diorama.settings.icon_size.tooltip: How big players and mobs are drawn on the minimap and the map.
diorama.settings.frame.tooltip: The border around the minimap: the dark frame, a clean Minecraft edge, or none.
diorama.settings.shape.tooltip: Whether the minimap is a square or a circle.
diorama.settings.radar_style.tooltip: How players and mobs show: their heads as pixel art, faces in boxes framed by mob type, or plain coloured dots.
